title: Add semantically-weighted change-impact estimator CI hook
author: Asha Menon
release_notes: Adds a CI hook that estimates semantic impact of prompt set changes and optionally gates merges when high-risk drift is detected. Backwards compatible; opt-in via eval-hooks config.
description: Context and motivation: Recently several prompt-set updates caused subtle regressions in downstream tasks even when token-level metrics barely moved. This PR introduces a semantically-weighted change-impact estimator CI hook that approximates the downstream risk of prompt changes by scoring semantic shifts across a prioritized probe set and mapping those shifts to historical regression likelihoods. Design summary: the hook computes embeddings for before/after prompt variants, clusters semantically-similar changes, weighs clusters by historical sensitivity (learned from a small labeled corpus of past regressions), and outputs a single impact score plus per-cohort explanations. The hook can be configured to soft-fail (annotate & block merge with warning) or hard-gate (fail CI) based on thresholds stored in eval-hooks.yaml. This behavior is opt-in per-repo via the ci/configs/eval-hooks.yaml toggles. Checklist and acceptance criteria: - Add deterministic unit tests for embedding diffs and cluster weighting - Add lightweight integration test that runs the hook against a small synthetic prompt delta - Document configuration knobs and recommended thresholds in docs/ci/semantic-impact.md - Include a fallback path that degrades to token-delta heuristic if embedding service is unreachable Commits (summary): - c1f9a2c: initial estimator implementation with clustering and weighting logic - 2b4e7d1: add CI hook shim and entrypoint, config parsing - e3d5b8f: tests for cluster stability and sensitivity-mapping - 7a2f1b0: docs and threshold guidance, update eval-hooks.yaml example - 9d8c0a4: fix flaky test by seeding random generator and add telemetry events Changed areas (high level): - eval_harness/hooks/semantic_impact_estimator.py: core estimator and CI entrypoint - eval_harness/tests/test_semantic_impact_estimator.py: unit + integration tests - ci/configs/eval-hooks.yaml: example config and default thresholds - docs/ci/semantic-impact.md: design notes, tuning guide, operational runbook - eval_harness/telemetry/emitters.py: add lightweight event hooks for impact telemetry - scripts/benchmarks/semantic-impact-smoke.py: local smoke runner Review conversation (high level timeline): - Diego Ramos (reviewer): "Nice shape. Can you clarify how the sensitivity weights are computed and persisted?" - Asha (author): "Added a detailed section in docs/ci/semantic-impact.md and included a small serialized baseline mapping under eval_harness/testdata/; weight computation is a simple logistic regression trained on historical diffs, re-trainable via make targets." - Linus Zhang (reviewer): "Concern: embedding calls could add CI flakiness. Suggest a deterministic fallback and caching of embeddings for identical prompts." - Asha: "Agree; implemented a cache layer with TTL and a fallback to token-delta heuristic; added tests to prove determinism when the embedding client returns repeated results." - Sofia Patel (approver): "Integration tests look solid, and the gating is opt-in which reduces risk. Approved after CI fix." CI history and outcome: - Initial run: lint failed (unused import) - Second run: lint/pass, unit tests flaky (timeout on external embedding mock) - Third run: added mock timeout handling, all tests passed; full CI green. Merge details: merged via squash on 2026-02-24 by Asha Menon. Post-merge notes: telemetry events emitted to team-dashboard under metric name eval.semantic_impact. Follow-up actions: - (ENG-3421) schedule a short experiment to calibrate thresholds on three prod prompt sets - Add a periodic backfill job to compute sensitivity weights from later regression labels
